No one should ever be afraid to post honest questions or critiques of decks posted in this forum. So do it!

Pascal:
Hungry Coyote is a good suggestion. Most of the time I take one of these actions:  Equip Laptop Computer Employ a retainer Steal Powerbase: Montreal Hunt.  Typically those actions are enough to keep my vampires busy. And if I don't have a Rapid Healing and/or Force of Will in hand, a plain old bleed for 2 does just fine.

Messages.Author: alek
Messages.Body:
what's the purpose of this build?

If you want to create efficient stealth & bleed deck, dom obf, pre obf, or dem obf would be muuuch better. But you are probably aware of it.

If you want to create stealt & bleed deck that has to be (because you lost some bet or for any other reason  based on fortitude than it looks more or less ok. I would just think of getting more superior disciplines, inferior force of will is just weak. You can change a crypt or play master module with villeins, 3-4 lilith's blessings and some disciplines. Such module prove its strenght in tournaments already.

If you want to create stealth % bleed deck that would be not just worse but different than tournament archetypes, you have to put more pressure on cards that can distinguish you from standard stealth and bleed. It's like making political deck with sabbat. You can just make it worse than camarrila (no parity shifts, etc.) or you can make it diffent using cards that you couldn't use when playing cama, f.e you could play tzimisce political deck with strong viccisitude combat or war ghouls support.
In your build the thing that distunguish this deck from other bleed decks is fortitude. So I would try to use it for something that is not possible to have in f.e malkavian s&b. It could be good offensive and defensive combat module with sticks, hidden strenght and indomitability.
You could play more darings to not just make your bleeds hard to block, but to make them unblockable by vampires.
Or you can use multiacting for something else than getting +bleed retainers, making it a kind of toolbox bleed. F.e make your crypt based on samedi and add pool gain module with little mountain cemetery.
